$comment: Phrases opencc-js converts wrongly in the Chinese Union Version, fixed after converting Traditional to Simplified. Traditional writes 著 for both zhe (穿著, wearing) and zhù (著名, famous), and the converter leaves 著 where Simplified writes 着 in these phrases: in 穿著白 and the like, and in 按著名, 得著称, and 遵著书, which it reads as the zhù words 著名, 著稱 (renowned), and 著書 (writing books). The pinyin converts the Simplified text again, where the converter turns the 著 of 著书 (writing books) into 着, so that one goes back. Each pair keeps the length, so pinyin stays lined up with the text. scripts/build-cuv-1919.mjs applies them to the Simplified text and services/BiblePinyinService.ts to the pinyin; test/cuv-1919-text.test.ts checks that 著 (zhù) is left only where it means famous or writing.
